title: An Infeasible Method with Feasibility Safeguard for Nonsmooth Composite Optimization Over Manifolds
summary: We study nonsmooth composite optimization over embedded submanifolds defined by nonlinear equality constraints. We propose a feasibility-safeguarded inexact proximal linearized method whose iterations require neither projection nor retraction onto the manifold. A computable smooth-dual residual certifies the approximate tangential step and controls the errors in both tangency and composite linearization consistency.
